fact: A WARDIP Guinea-Bissau post of 8 August 2026 announces that the government approved the national interoperability regulation (regulamento nacional de interoperabilidade), giving no number or year and no gazette date; an appended note in the document says only a draft decree is independently confirmed. Dated by the post's published date.

ANG reports the Council of Ministers approved a draft decree (Projeto de Decreto) on the Regulamento sobre a Interoperabilidade de Sistemas e Plataformas Digitais dos Servicos Publicos e Privados, with no number given; date taken from the article's Thursday Council meeting, 10 July 2025.
system: Regulamento sobre a Interoperabilidade de Sistemas e Plataformas Digitais
source_slug: 2025-07-10 Guinea-Bissau Council of Ministers approves three digital decrees (interoperability, data governance, cybersecurity)

fact: WARDIP reports the government approved the Regulamento Nacional de Interoperabilidade de Sistemas e Plataformas Digitais dos Servicos Publicos e Privados by Decreto n.o 27/2025 (a decree), published in the Boletim Oficial of 31 October 2025; it states the regulation lets public entities share information securely, without saying they are obliged to.
